proposition.claim:
The source works with a matrix field \(A\) and a relatively closed defect set \(S\). In addition to \(\operatorname{supp}\operatorname{Curl}A\subset S\), admissibility requires every relevant closed-loop circulation outside \(S\) to lie in \(\tau\varepsilon\mathbb Z^2\), where \(\tau,\varepsilon>0\) [Retained latex: \cite[p.~4, (H2)]{FGS}]. The energy is the sum of a quadratic distance from \(\mathrm{SO}(2)\) outside the core and the core area, divided by \(\varepsilon\).

Equation reference: eq:M. For the interpolation lemma, put \[Q_{\ell,L}^0=(0,\ell)\times(0,L),\qquad
 G=\ell\int_0^L |g(t)|^2\,dt,\qquad
 q=\frac{\tau\varepsilon}{\ell},\] where \(L,\ell>0\), \(\ell\ge\varepsilon\) and \(g\in L^2_{\rm loc}(\mathbb R;\mathbb R^2)\). The source additionally assumes \(G<\varepsilon L\) for its quantitative estimate and sets \[
 M=\left(\frac{L\varepsilon}{G}\right)^{1/3},\qquad
 N=\left\lfloor\frac{L}{M\ell}\right\rfloor+1.\] The case \(g=0\) is treated separately. Each complete strip \(E_i\) has height \(M\ell\), and the final strip has the remaining height. On a strip with bottom coordinate \(y_i\), the local primitive is \[u_i(x_1,x_2)=
 \left(1-\frac{x_1}{\ell}\right)\int_{y_i}^{x_2}g(t)\,dt,\qquad A_i=\nabla u_i.\] Thus \(A_i e_1=0\) on its bottom and \[A_i e_1=\bar g_i:=-\ell^{-1}
       \int_{y_i}^{y_i+M\ell}g(t)\,dt\] on its top when the strip is complete.

Equation reference: eq:printed. The source defines \(g_i^\varepsilon=P_{\tau\varepsilon\mathbb Z^2}(\ell\bar g_i)/\ell\), using componentwise floor projection, and assembles \[
 A=A_1\chi_{E_1}
   +\sum_{i=2}^{N}\chi_{E_i}
       \bigl[A_i+(g_{i-1}^{\varepsilon}-\bar g_{i-1})\otimes e_1\bigr].\] The assertion immediately before source (6.13) is that the jumps of \(Ae_1\) belong to \(q\mathbb Z^2\). This is the property examined next.

Recorded check: The offsets in Lemma 6.3 do not preserve the lattice jumps

tau=L=1, epsilon=ell=1/10, g(t)=e1/8 for all real t; g is nonzero L2loc, ell>=epsilon and G=ell integral|g|^2=1/640<epsilon L.

repair.content:
Let c1=0 and c_(i+1)=c_i+gbar_i-P_q(c_i+gbar_i), Atilde_i=A_i+c_i tensor e1. Then jumps=-P_q(c_i+gbar_i) lie in qZ^2 and every residual lies in[0,q)^2.

Retain d=(mu_tilde-mu,eta_tilde-eta), a=((mu+mu_tilde)/2,(eta+eta_tilde)/2-1). Bound dist^2 by C|d|^2[h^2/ell^2+h^4/ell^2(1/x2^2+x1^2/x2^4)]+2|a|^2.
